whoFor: Businesses planning to sell in a new region, city or country, including foreign businesses entering Nigeria.

benefits.title: Fewer surprises
benefits.text: Market, regulatory and operating questions answered before you commit.

benefits.title: A sequence to follow
benefits.text: What to do first, second and third, written down.

benefits.title: Local coordination
benefits.text: One team that can also carry out the Nigerian set-up steps when you are ready.

whatYouReceive: A market entry assessment for the chosen location
A step-by-step entry plan with owners
A list of registrations and permits to plan for
whatYouProvide: Your goals for the new market and your current operating model
Your budget range and risk appetite, for planning purposes only
Decisions from your side at each stage
doesNotInclude: Registrations themselves, which are scoped separately
